_comment: Published per WP-SCP-022 020H.1 (closes 020H part 3 (xi) freshness-warning forward-looking flag). The reusable workflow's freshness-warning step compares this manifest at SCP main HEAD against the manifest at the wrapper's SHA pin (in .scp-runtime/version-manifest.json) and emits ::warning:: when the wrapper is more than `freshness_warning_threshold_minor` minor versions behind. The threshold is read from the PINNED manifest, not from main HEAD (closes 020H.1 R1 SAFE-MIN-006). Bump `version` + `minor` + `released_at` together on every release. See policies/VERSIONING.md for the semver contract. v1.4.0 introduces WP-SCP-030 Phase B.1 (D-058 second domain / proving ground) — one new domain rule: SCP-R-030 (hooked-repo onboarding conformance; warn baseline). Additive-rule MINOR. The rule ships loaded but vacuous-passes in production until a companion workflow PR materialises input.rule_config + input.claude_md* into the evaluation envelope (the SCP-R-006 safe-failure precedent). Enforcement reach = hooked-set ∩ SCP-cohort = {CT, PIM, SCP-self} (see policies/VERSIONING.md SCP-R-030 note). D-060 reserved for the post-4-week-observation deny-promotion outcome.
_schema_note: No JSON Schema $schema URL — version-manifest.json is a load-bearing public surface (every adopter wrapper at 020H.1+ reads this at workflow run time) but the shape is small and stable; fields are documented in policies/VERSIONING.md and ADOPT-001 §12.7.11. If the surface grows, file a schema at schemas/version-manifest.schema.json (closes 020H.1 R1 COR-MANIFEST-002).
